verdict.rationale: Stripe documents official Terminal SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native. There is a public first-party GitHub repo for the JS SDK, a versioned SDK migration guide (v5.0.0), and a built-in simulated reader for developing and testing against the SDKs without hardware. A community developer praises terminal-level API integration but does not speak to the SDKs specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs' quality and coverage, beyond first-party claims.
